reference_sql:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per MRR change
  SELECT subscription_id, event_type,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, event_id) AS rn
  FROM subscription_events
)
SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS subscriptions
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY event_type
alternatives:
WITH latest AS (  -- one row per subscription
  SELECT e.subscription_id, e.event_type
  FROM subscription_events e
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscription_events e2
                    WHERE e2.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
                      AND (e2.recorded_at > e.recorded_at OR (e2.recorded_at = e.recorded_at AND e2.event_id < e.event_id)))
)
SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS subscriptions
FROM latest
GROUP BY event_type

SELECT t.event_type, COUNT(*) AS subscriptions
FROM (
  -- one row per MRR change, numbered within its subscription from the latest
  SELECT subscription_id, event_type,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, event_id) AS rn
  FROM subscription_events
) AS t
WHERE t.rn = 1
GROUP BY t.event_type

other_way.sql:
WITH latest AS (  -- one row per subscription
  SELECT e.subscription_id, e.event_type
  FROM subscription_events e
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscription_events e2
                    WHERE e2.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
                      AND (e2.recorded_at > e.recorded_at OR (e2.recorded_at = e.recorded_at AND e2.event_id < e.event_id)))
)
SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS subscriptions
FROM latest
GROUP BY event_type
other_way.tradeoff: NOT EXISTS finds each subscription's latest change without a window, at the cost of comparing every change with the others.
